news.Title: 瑞銀下調韓股未來12個月目標至8千點，利率、油價及韓元升值成壓力
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，瑞銀將韓國首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)未來12個月目標由8,800點下調至8,000點，降幅約9.09%，主要反映利率與油價上升，以及韓元升值可能對韓國企業獲利造成壓力。韓國經濟高度依賴能源進口，油價維持高檔將增加製造、運輸及化工等產業的成本；另一方面，利率走高不僅推升企業融資成本，也可能壓抑內需及股票估值。韓元升值則會降低出口商換算回本國貨幣後的營收與獲利，對半導體、汽車及電子產品出口商的影響尤其受到關注。

瑞銀分析師表示，KOSPI中長期仍有可觀上漲空間，但在即將到來的第三季及第四季財報季更清楚呈現獲利可持續性，以及企業提出具體股東回報計畫之前，指數可能維持區間震盪，市場短期將更重視企業財測及資本配置政策。

韓股先前受惠AI晶片、記憶體價格上漲及公司治理改革預期而走強，但高油價與韓元升值正形成新的總體經濟逆風。後續觀察重點包括三星電子(005930.KS)、SK海力士(000660.KS)等權值股財報，以及企業能否透過提高股息、庫藏股與註銷持股等措施，支撐估值及外資買盤。

news.Title: 台股收漲538點！聯發科衝破5000元大關 友達攻漲停
news.Content:
台股今（21）日開高走高，上漲538點收47718點，漲幅1.14%，成交量8200億；資金集中在面板三虎、PCB、封測族群。

權值股部分，台積電來到2480元，上漲20元，漲幅0.81%，聯發科來到5010元創新高，上漲300元，漲幅6.37%，鴻海則小跌5元來到250元，跌幅0.2%，台達電則大漲逾8%。

觀察今日盤面，封測、PCB族群齊揚，封測概念股中，南茂攻漲停來到103元，成交量約6.2萬張，日月光上漲3.92%，來到663元，京元電上漲3.43%，來到301.5元，力成、超豐也有逾3%的漲幅；PCB中，聯茂大漲逾7%，台燿上漲逾4%，欣興上漲39元來到1020元，重返1000元關卡，漲幅3.98%，耀華、金像電也上漲逾2%。

面板三虎也有不錯的表現，友達收漲停來到33.35元，爆出81.8萬張大量，群創上漲逾4%，收50.4元，彩晶也有5.71%的漲幅，收14.8元。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 聯發科首度突破5000元，加權指數無畏低量將挑戰史高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃俊超】美股上週五道瓊下跌0.18%、S&P500上漲0.17%、Nasdaq上漲0.39%、費城半導體上漲2.78%。德國股市下跌1.6%、法國下跌1.49%。日經指數反彈回到均線糾結，下一個要挑戰轉為下彎的60日均線，韓國綜合指數反彈回到60日均線之上，將挑戰120日均線與橫盤整理的上區間。中國上證指數反彈回到短中期均線之上，依舊是處在區間整理格局之內，香港恆生指數反彈，均線持續趨於糾結。美元指數來到100~101，新台幣31.5~32，日圓近日回貶至157附近。

加權指數週一震盪開高走高，終場上漲538.09點、1.14%，收在47718.84點，成交量為8202.15億元，持續逼近歷史高48218.87點，成交量能持續偏低，擴散性與連續性不易發揮，不過只要集中在權值股就已足夠。技術面上，短中期均線趨於糾結，且已全面轉為上彎，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸，日MACD指標黑色柱狀體減少至接近零軸。

櫃檯指數則相對受到壓抑，終場下跌0.11點、0.03%，收在412.57點，成交量為2117.14億元，上週五的紅K棒站上所有均線後，今日呈現量縮整理，若再有一根紅棒突破整理區間，則就有機會挑戰歷史高459.56點，日KD指標交叉向上後延伸，日MACD指標柱狀體由黑轉紅。

台積電(2330)漲0.81%，在所有均線之上，聯發科(2454)漲6.37%，盤中創歷史新高5035元，收盤也站上5000元，台達電(2308)漲8.07%、鴻海(2317)跌0.2%、日月光投控(3711)漲3.92%，電子權值股創意(3443)、健策(3653)、貿聯(3665)、欣興(3037)與致茂(2360)漲幅超過3%，金融類股則以凱基金(2883)、富邦金(2881)與國泰金(2882)漲幅超過2%，傳產股則為各自表述。

news.Title: Amazon.com vs. Uber Technologies: Analyzing Recent Quarterly Revenue Trends Between Two Consumer Companies
news.Content:
Amazon.com: Tracking Recent Financial Scale

Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) primarily earns revenue by selling consumer goods online and providing cloud computing services to enterprise clients.

While entering a commercial agreement with NVIDIA to acquire two million additional graphics processing units, it reported a 14% operating margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Uber Technologies: Monitoring Digital Network Expansion

Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) generates revenue by connecting consumers with independent transport providers for ride-hailing and local delivery services.

It announced a business combination agreement to acquire Delivery Hero SE , and it posted a 15% operating margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Why Revenue Matters for Investors in This Comparison

Foolish Take

Amazon demonstrates sales spikes in the fourth quarter, when it receives a boost from the holiday shopping season. How this pattern changes over time is worth observing as the e-commerce giant increasingly capitalizes on the artificial intelligence boom. Its Amazon Web Services (AWS) division, under which its AI offerings fall, delivered 37% year-over-year sales growth to $42.2 billion in the second quarter, its fastest growth in 18 quarters in a sign the company's AI solutions are gaining traction.

Amazon is on a mission to make AI accessible to a broad range of businesses, just as AWS did for cloud computing. It has provided an AI shopping assistant for retailers to adopt, and is using its AI for a budding autonomous vehicle (AV) company called Zoox.

Amazon partnered with Uber in a multi-year deal to bring Zoox into Uber's ecosystem, starting with Las Vegas this year and Los Angeles in 2027. For its long-term business growth, Uber has made similar deals with other AV enterprises.

However, Uber's partnership with prominent AV company Waymo, owned by Google parent Alphabet , appears to be ending. Their pilot in Phoenix ended this year with additional cities coming off Uber's app in the future. This shouldn't be a big drag on sales given Waymo's limited involvement in Uber's ecosystem.

news.Title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Soars 3.3%: Is Further Upside Left in the Stock?
news.Content:
Texas Instruments TXN shares rallied 3.3% in the last trading session to close at $266.64. This move can be attributable to notable volume with a higher number of shares being traded than in a typical session. This compares to the stock's 2.8% loss over the past four weeks.

The optimism surrounding the stock can be attributed to Texas Instruments raising its quarterly dividend by 7% to $1.52 per share, marking its 23rd consecutive year of dividend increases. Further, strong demand across industrial, automotive and data center markets is supporting the company's growth prospects, with second-quarter revenue rising 23% year over year, while data center revenue doubled and industrial revenue increased around 30%.

This chipmaker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $2.39 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +61.5%. Revenues are expected to be $5.91 billion, up 24.7% from the year-ago quarter.

Earnings and revenue growth expectations certainly give a good sense of the potential strength in a stock, but empirical research shows that trends in earnings estimate revisions are strongly correlated with near-term stock price movements.

For Texas Instruments, the consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has remained unchanged over the last 30 days. And a stock's price usually doesn't keep moving higher in the absence of any trend in earnings estimate revisions. So, make sure to keep an eye on TXN going forward to see if this recent jump can turn into more strength down the road.

The stock currently carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

Texas Instruments is a member of the Zacks Semiconductor - General industry. One other stock in the same industry, STMicroelectronics STM, finished the last trading session 3.2% higher at $50.18. STM has returned -2.6% over the past month.

For STMicroelectronics, the consensus EPS estimate for the upcoming report has remained unchanged over the past month at $0.4. This represents a change of +37.9% from what the company reported a year ago. STMicroelectronics currently has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

news.Title: 還在無腦存0050？專家點名10檔ETF報酬率完勝：成敗都因台積電
news.Content:
國民ETF元大台灣50（0050）過去靠著 台積電 一路強勢飆漲，成為台灣投資人無腦存股的首選。（資料照，中央社）

國民ETF元大台灣50（0050）過去靠著台積電一路強勢飆漲，成為台灣投資人無腦存股的首選。不過隨著AI概念股群雄並起、市值型與半導體ETF大放異彩，0050的績效竟已悄悄落後。知名財經作家「不敗教主」 陳重銘 在臉書發文直言，0050現在表現只能算「中段班」，早就被一堆高彈性ETF狠狠超車​，核心原因就在於過度集中在單一檔台積電。​陳重銘也點名今年台股績效前10強的ETF。​

「大象很難往上跳！」台積電市值逼近70兆　漲幅遭小型AI股拉開差距

陳重銘剖析，0050過去能創造亮眼報酬，全靠台積電從60元一路飆到2500元的輝煌歷史。但時移勢易，如今的台積電市值已逼近70兆大關「大象很難往上跳」，其中更有2點關鍵：

第一，權重過重成雙面刃： 0050有近6成的持股重壓在台積電一檔股票上。當台積電因為體量過大、漲幅開始輸給市值較小的AI飆股時，過度集中的0050績效自然被大幅拉低。

第二，監管紅線與分散性： 為了避免單一成分股風險過高，金管會規定ETF持有台積電的權重不得超過大盤。在今年以來績效前十強的台股ETF中，台積電權重最高也僅占40%。

00913飆出106%稱霸榜首　陳重銘點名10強ETF贏在「分散性」

陳重銘指出，根據數據顯示，今年以來台股ETF績效前10強中，冠軍由兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）以高達106.69%的驚人報酬率奪下；二、三名則分別為富邦台灣半導體（00892）的96.82%及野村臺灣新科技50（00935）的94.79%。

news.Title: CPO是下一波主戰場？ 花旗點名「7台廠」商機大爆發
news.Content:
台灣半導體供應鏈具備強勁營運能見度，AI成長正從GPU擴展至網路、客製化ASIC、共封裝光學與先進封裝，輝達維持生態系統優勢，而CPO則成為解決頻寬與功耗瓶頸的核心升級。根據花旗環球發布的最新研報指出，AI基礎設施週期在2028年後的延續性與價值升級，將持續為台灣半導體供應鏈帶來強勁能見度。

算力需求延伸至網路與CPU

花旗研究團隊表示，客製化ASIC單位出貨量雖從低基期快速成長，但輝達仍將持續佔據系統價值的主要份額。然而，除了加速器之外，下一個主要成長動能將日益來自網路晶片與CPU。市場常引用的台積電AI成長指標，主要反映GPU與ASIC相關營收，尚未完整體現網路晶片或代理人AI驅動的CPU潛在需求。隨著這些新增類別規模擴大，邏輯半導體的成長將重新獲得投資人關注。產業的核心問題已不再只是GPU需求是否強勁，而是超大型雲端業者的資本支出與AI模型商業化能否支撐龐大的基礎設施承諾。

台積電先進製程與封裝優勢

花旗報告分析，台積電(2330)幾乎參與了每一項重大AI硬體轉型，且其AI商機遠寬於傳統GPU/ASIC範疇。網路晶片、AI CPU、矽光子與先進封裝均提供額外成長動能。受惠於2奈米全年度貢獻、3奈米AI晶片出貨量增加及潛在價格調漲，台積電2027年將迎來出貨量、產品組合與平均售價擴張的強勁成長。競爭格局方面，英特爾自身CPU仍需大量先進製程產能，同時支援內部產品與大型外部AI客戶的能力受限。相比之下，台積電的製造規模與供應鏈協調能力仍是核心優勢，策略上也更加精挑細選地投入資本與工程資源，優先保留前段製造、SoIC與矽光子等差異化技術，並將較傳統的後段封裝交由專業外包廠商。

日月光迎外包與CPO紅利

由於先進製程晶圓與CoWoS產能持續緊張，花旗認為台積電有動力優先發展前段製造與SoIC，並將更多後段製程外包。日月光(3711)投控已參與基板相關外包工作，隨生態系統成熟將獲更多機會。此外，日月光投控正開發包含FoCoS在內的全流程先進封裝能力，能更直接獲取高價值AI封裝營收，AMD即為其重要客戶與觸媒。CPO則被視為下一個明確的硬體轉型，同時解決數據傳輸頻寬與功耗兩大瓶頸。輝達預計將透過Spectrum-X CPO交換機及次世代NVLink架構與Rubin Ultra成為初期推手。交換機層級的CPO將較早規模化。大立光(3008)憑藉高精度自動化能力，也有機會在技術難度最高的光纖陣列對準流程中掌握CPO商機。

客製化晶片與電源架構演進

在客製化ASIC領域，Google TPU生態系統展現了龐大商機。花旗預計聯發科(2454)的角色將大幅提升，初期目標市場份額為15%至20%，未來上行空間更大。在TPU v8世代，聯發科集中於I/O、SerDes與晶圓處理；到了下一世代，其範圍將擴大至部分計算執行領域，先進製程計算內容將顯著提升其單一設備價值。世芯-KY(3661)也在Google CPU項目中展現成長，採用純COT模式提供後段服務。系統與電源層面，鴻海(2317)為輝達機櫃級轉型的主要受惠者。隨著供應鏈從GB300過渡至Vera Rubin，產品平均售價大幅提升，帶動營收與利潤增加，鴻海亦積極布局客製化ASIC及超大型雲端業者系統。至於800VDC電源架構，花旗認為其導入將是循序漸進而非立即全面採用，台達電(2308)在高功率資料中心基礎設施中依然佔據有利位置。

news.Title: 逾6成民眾預期台股上漲　國泰國民經濟信心調查一次看
news.Content:
國人對台股投資信心強烈，根據國泰金今天發布的9月國民經濟信心調查結果顯示，高達62.6%的受訪民眾預期未來半年台股將會上漲，看壞認為會下跌的民眾僅13.6％。

此外，想把現金/定存轉入股票投資的，有42.7％增加意願；不變的則有47.5％。

另外，民眾對於台股的樂觀指數回升至49.1，風險偏好指數上升至32.9。

以下是各項調查結果重點：

●民眾景氣展望樂觀指數與消費意願回升：

國發會最新公布的7月景氣對策信號續呈紅燈，領先指標及同時指標續呈上升，景氣仍呈穩健成長。

本月調查顯示，受訪民眾的景氣樂觀指數反彈，其中景氣現況樂觀指數上升至 14.8，展望樂觀指數上升至16.5。

消費意願也同步改善，其中大額消費意願指數升至18.3，耐久財消費意願指數升至-3.9。

●52%民眾預期2026年經濟成長率高於11%，51%預期通膨高於2.5%：

主計總處於2026年8月14日預估台灣2026年經濟成長率11.05%，通貨膨脹率 2.07%。

本月調查結果顯示，受訪民眾對於2026年經濟成長率的平均預期值為10.89%，有52%認為會高於11%。

而受訪民眾對於2026年平均通膨預期值為2.51%，且有高達51%認為通貨膨脹率會高於2.5%。

相較於主計總處，受訪民眾對於2026年的經濟成長預估與主計總處接近，但通膨預期依舊較高。

另外，國泰也詢問民眾對於未來一年物價水準與通貨膨脹率預期。

◼調查顯示，79%的受訪民眾預期一年以後通貨膨脹率大於2%，其中35%預期將大於3%。

news.Title: 電子＋金融股拉抬，加權指數早盤攻上47600點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／魏聖峰】受到上週五費城半導體指數反彈將近3%、南韓股市週一早盤表現不錯並上漲1.7%的激勵，台股在期貨領先上漲帶動下，加權指數早盤開高走高，並突破47600點，距離前波歷史高點48218.87點僅剩下約567點(1.19%)。今天大盤預估量約8470.52億元，較上週五的1.1423兆元略低。不過，如果成交量能維持在8500億元以上，對大盤而言都屬正面表列。台股早盤在台積電(2330)、聯發科(2454)、台達電(2308)、日月光投控(3711)、欣興(3037)、致茂(2360)、健策(3653)、川湖(2059)、南亞(1303)、友達(2409)、國巨*(2327)、研華(2395)、京元電子(2449)、光寶科(2301)以及金融股上漲帶動下領漲。台積電一度上漲約0.61%，股價維持在2480元上下震盪，雖然股價漲幅不是很大，卻維持震盪盤堅格局，給大盤帶來多頭力道支撐。但成熟製程的聯電(2303)、世界(5347)和力積電(6770)等股，短線股價漲多後震盪拉回，但跌幅不算大。聯電集團的宏齊(6168)、聯傑(3094)股價都攻到漲停板鎖死，聯傑已經是連二日上漲。

高價IC設計股表現依然強勢，在聯發科、信驊(5274)、世芯-KY(3661)、創意(3443)股價帶動下，31檔股價漲幅超過4%，達發(6526)股價漲幅3.91%，聯陽(3014)、盛群(6202)、瑞昱(2379)、巨有科技(8227)股價表現都不錯。封測族群股價表現也強勢，在日月光投控和京元電子股價領漲下，華東(8110)、南茂(8150)、菱生(2369)、力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)、超豐(2441)、福懋科(8131)、台星科(3265)、矽格(2357)等股表現不錯。

CCL族群上週回檔，但週一早盤股價嘗試止跌，聯茂(6213)、台燿(6274)股價在平盤以上震盪，台光電(2383)股價小跌。ABF龍頭指標欣興早盤股價上漲重回千元以上，嘗試從先前利空中走出來。達邁(3645)、燿華(2367)、亞電(4939)、富喬(1815)、金像電(2368)、健鼎(3044)等股在平盤以上震盪。

被動元件股週一全面反彈，國巨*、聚鼎(6224)、艾華(6204)、雷科(6207)、九豪(6127)、華新科(2492)、千如(3236)、金山電(8042)等股都有表現。CPO強勢股則有華星光(4979)、波若威(3163)、聯亞(3081)、光環(3234)等股表現強勢，光聖(6442)、前鼎(4908)、上銓(3363)等股則下跌。

金融股的富邦金(2881)、凱基金(2883)、國泰金(2882)、中信金(2891)、永豐金(2890)、元大金(2885)等股表現不錯，對拉抬指數有不錯的效果。在南亞(1303)、台塑化(6505)股價帶動下，台達化(1309)、亞聚(1308)、聯成(1313)、台塑(1301)、台化(1326)等塑化股表現也強勢。

news.Title: 傳台積電、英特爾接連傳找上門！ 友達亮燈飆漲停 9萬張單排隊等著買
news.Content:
面板廠友達（2409）近期轉型半導體先進封裝再傳新進展，市場消息指出，英特爾（Intel）積極布局Micro LED基板先進封裝，傳出有意與友達合作，雙方可能攜手搶攻共同封裝光學（CPO）及高密度算力晶片整合商機；另一方面，市場也傳出台積電（2330）看上友達中科5代、7.5代廠房，相關消息一出，友達今（21）日股價亮燈漲停，逾9萬張買單排隊等著買。

根據《經濟日報》報導，英特爾取得「IC Package with Micro LEDs」美國授權專利，透過玻璃基板、TGV技術整合Micro LED與半導體晶片。由於友達近年同樣投入Micro LED、玻璃基板、TGV（玻璃通孔）、RDL（重布線層）及CPO等領域，雙方技術路線有所交集，因此合作傳聞受到市場高度關注。不過，目前相關合作尚未獲雙方正式證實，英特爾對市場傳聞不予評論，友達也未公布具體合作對象。

友達先前另傳出與台積電（2330）合作進軍面板級封裝，不過目前相關消息均未獲雙方正式證實。友達董事長彭双浪先前曾透露，公司已布局先進封裝與玻璃基板，並與合作夥伴共同開發相關技術。今年9月SEMICON Taiwan期間，友達也與康寧共同展示510×515毫米大尺寸玻璃核心基板技術，瞄準AI伺服器晶片大型化與高密度互連需求。此外，友達也持續布局Micro LED及光通訊，並朝CPO應用發展，預計相關技術約在2028年進一步進入量產。

受利多消息激勵，友達21日開高走高，中午11時許亮燈漲停，大漲3元，來到33.35元，漲福9.88%。

不只友達，群創（3481）同樣受惠先進封裝題材，早盤一度上漲約3.8%，重返50元關卡。群創近年積極推進扇出型面板級封裝（FOPLP），目前已進入量產及出貨階段。相較之下，友達則從面板製程與玻璃技術切入半導體相關應用，面板雙虎正加速尋找傳統顯示器之外的新成長動能。

news.Title: AI電力軟體族群撐盤 台股高檔震盪 009831瞄準算力掌4大黃金配置
news.Content:
AI題材持續主導台股資金動向，加權指數今 (21) 日震盪走高，除半導體與AI伺服器供應鏈維持人氣外，重電、能源及雲端軟體概念股也同步吸引買盤進駐。法人指出，AI產業正從過去建置算力的上半場，逐步邁向算力變現的新階段，市場關注焦點也從硬體延伸至電力、軟體與應用服務。

近期華城 (1519-TW)、士電 (1503-TW)、中興電 (1513-TW)、亞力 (1514-TW)等重電族群表現強勢，反映AI資料中心帶來龐大電力需求。市場分析，AI競賽不只是GPU與伺服器的競爭，更牽動電網升級、能源配送與備援電力等基礎建設需求，AI的盡頭是電力已成市場共識。

根據國際能源總署（IEA）統計，以AI為主的資料中心，2025年用電量年增幅達50%，2030年前全球資料中心用電需求更有機會接近翻倍。投信法人表示，AI推論與代理型AI（AI Agent）普及後，單次任務耗電量大幅提升，未來AI使用量增加，也將同步推升電力供應鏈需求。

另一方面，AI商業模式也逐漸明朗。包括Google Cloud、Microsoft Copilot與Tesla FSD等服務，已開始將AI使用量轉化為實際營收與獲利，市場認為，AI產業下一階段將進入企業付費、軟體訂閱與應用落地的變現時代。

不過，目前台股AI受惠重心仍偏向晶片與硬體供應鏈，資訊服務與數位雲端相關市值占比相對有限。隨著AI投資邏輯轉向電力與應用並重，市場近期也開始關注橫跨電力、硬體、軟體與應用的全球AI主題ETF。

富蘭克林華美投信即將推出FT核心AI電力算力ETF（009831-TW），預計10月5日至10月8日展開募集，採電力供應鏈40%、硬體20%、軟體20%、應用20%固定配置，聚焦AI發展過程中最具成長潛力的四大領域，涵蓋電網、核能、晶片、雲端軟體及AI應用等產業鏈，希望掌握AI從算力建設到應用變現的完整商機。

法人分析，過去3年市場賺的是蓋算力的錢，下一波AI行情關鍵，將是誰能真正把算力轉化為營收與獲利；在AI需求持續擴張下，電力、軟體與應用服務的重要性正持續升溫。

news.Title: 元大金看H2台股量能高檔，外幣放款/財管續成長
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-21 10:55:37 李宜秦 發佈

元大金(2885)展望下半年證券市場成交量雖預期較上半年降溫，但整體量能仍可望明顯高於去年，加上ETF市場持續擴張，有利經紀、套利、造市及資產管理等業務延續動能；銀行端則將持續擴大外幣放款、理財型房貸及優質無擔保信貸，並以維持淨利息收益率（NIM）在1.13%左右為主要管理方向，財富管理手續費收入下半年則預期仍有約3成成長空間。

證券業務方面，元大金預估，下半年台股日均成交量約落在1兆至1.2兆元，低於上半年約1.27兆元，但仍明顯高於2025年全年約5,325億元。公司認為，台股中長期仍具一定續航力，關鍵在於美國AI投資循環及大型科技業者資本支出能否延續；若AI基礎建設投資持續，台灣仍將是全球AI供應鏈主要受惠市場之一。2026年上半年元大證券經紀市占率已升至16.5%，新開戶月均約4.9萬戶，大戶數亦增至1.55萬戶，市占率擴張成為後續營運另一支撐。

除成交量外，元大金也看好ETF市場的結構性成長。公司指出，台灣ETF市場規模已由2023年的約6.3兆元擴大至今年上半年約11兆元，其中股票型ETF增幅尤其明顯。ETF規模擴張除了帶動元大投信資產管理規模，也增加元大證券套利與造市機會；目前證券自營收益約75%來自套利、造市及量化交易，因此後續獲利表現主要觀察日均成交量、ETF規模與市場波動度，而非單純取決於股市漲跌。

銀行方面，元大金表示，下半年放款仍將維持穩定成長，外幣放款為主要動能之一，其中將優先推動利差相對較佳的OBU業務，目前鎖定澳洲、韓國具信用條件的企業；此外，理財型房貸及以證券、銀行高資產或高信用客群為主的無擔保個人信貸，也將是後續成長來源。第二季底元大銀行外幣放款約1,365億元、年增72%，占整體放款比重已由2024年底的4.3%提高至8.7%。

隨放款結構調整，元大銀行第二季NIM已升至1.13%，優於原先全年1.11%至1.12%的目標，元大金表示，後續將以穩定維持1.13%左右為主要方向。財富管理方面，上半年財管手續費收入年增45%，主要由銀保、基金等產品帶動，對下半年仍維持正向看法，預期財管手續費收入可望年增約30%，但實際增幅仍視市場環境及客戶投資活動而定。

海外布局方面，元大金仍將證券業務視為主要擴張方向，目前海外證券事業已布局韓國、香港、泰國、越南、柬埔寨及印尼等亞洲市場，上半年海外獲利約24.5億元，短期目標為將海外獲利貢獻穩定提高至12%至15%。未來併購將較傾向海外市場，以亞太證券業務為主，不排除透過併購擴大既有市場規模，或切入具獲利潛力的新市場。

至於股利政策，元大金維持現金股利發放率50%至60%的長期指引，管理層表示，以目前營運情況來看，今年發放率較傾向區間高端、接近60%，最終仍須視全年實際獲利並由董事會決議。公司2026至2030年的ROE目標則維持9%至11%，在擴大證券、銀行及海外業務的同時，仍將維持既有風控及資本配置原則。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】漲逾500點　台積電領軍電子權值勁揚
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年9月21日電）美股期指揚升，韓國股市勁揚，台股今天開高走堅，盤中高檔整理盤堅，最高47728.78點，上漲548.03點，台積電領軍電子權值股走揚，金融翻紅。

到10時40分，加權指數47686.8點，上漲506.05點，成交值約新台幣4800億元，電子指數漲1.33%，金融指數漲0.46%，代表中小型股的櫃買OTC指數下跌0.16%。

權王台積電 (2330) 翻紅盤中最高2485元，漲25元，漲幅1.01%，主要電子權值股聯發科 (2454) 漲5%，台達電 (2308) 漲近6%，日月光投控 (3711) 漲3.5%，鴻海 (2317) 力守平盤，記憶體族群南亞科 (2408) 跌逾1%，印刷電路板廠欣興 (3037) 揚升5.5%，被動元件廠國巨 (2327) 漲逾1%，IC載板廠南電 (8046) 跌1.8%。

股價超過千元的高價股漲跌互見，欣興重返千元俱樂部，高價股增至「48千金」。

台新台灣優勢成長主動式ETF基金經理人魏永祥指出，上週美國聯邦準備理事會（Fed）如市場預期升息1碼，台股先前回檔反應，聯準會確定升息後美股及台股利空出盡，台股連日大漲，今天盤中持續上攻，站穩47500點之上。

魏永祥表示，人工智慧AI基礎建設規格提升，包括晶圓代工、測試介面、散熱、電源、銅箔基板和印刷電路板、ABF載板、光通訊，網通等族群持續受惠，隨著大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）積極自研AI特殊應用晶片（ASIC），相關供應鏈重要性持續提升，IC設計服務、先進封裝與高速傳輸技術具長期發展潛力。

news.Title: 資金輪動下掌握台股AI行情 法人：主動市值ETF最方便
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-21 10:39:21 新聞中心 發佈

近年來AI科技的興起不僅帶動相關投資火熱，也推升全球主要股市表現，儘管市場走勢近期常受AI概念股估值疑慮與其落地變現進展干擾，不過整體來看，在AI需求續強下，相關投資仍持續領航全球股市表現。而在這波AI浪潮中，具備技術與零組件生產優勢的台灣更是資金青睞重點。

市場法人表示，隨著AI算力建置與應用需求快速成長，台灣憑藉著完整的AI供應鏈，近年股市表現突顯，近三年的台股報酬風險比高達1.58，居主要市場之冠，建議投資人不妨透過主動市值台股ETF來參與，既有市值龍頭股堅實的獲利能力作後盾，也順勢掌握重點趨勢題材，更靈活完整跟上台股成長脈動。

群益投信主動式ETF研究團隊表示，AI興起不僅帶動台灣出口表現，也激勵台股表現，在科技市值龍頭股的領軍下屢寫新高，而AI熱潮外溢也讓多檔千金股因勢而生，企業市值排名亦隨之洗牌，因此要掌握AI大勢下的台股成長行情，能彈性選股的主動式市值型台股ETF可說是最為方便的工具，在資金輪動的環境中，有望更即時與精準的掌握趨勢行情。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，近期台股雖受國際政經因素干擾而高檔震盪，不過整體來看，台股自2023年下半年以來的企業盈餘上修循環未變，AI資本支出與企業盈餘雙重上修動能延續，台股中長期表現仍值期待，而相關供應鏈股也將持續是台股投資主軸，不過在資金輪動下，類股表現自過去全面齊漲轉為輪動加速、個股分化，因此也更加講求主動選股、汰弱留強，以更即時掌握AI多元商機。次產業方面，包括先進製程、封裝、載板、散熱、電源模組等值得留意。

news.Title: 聯發科天璣9600 Pro登場，強化資料中心XPU布局
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-21 10:30:34 數位內容中心 發佈

聯發科（2454）近期同步推進旗艦手機晶片、5G高精準定位與資料中心客製化晶片布局，先發布天璣9600 Pro與天璣9600 M，再與愛立信完成基於3GPP Release 16標準的GNSS RTK端到端測試，並把NVIDIA合作範圍拉高到NVLink Fusion架構下的客製化XPU。產品線從手機SoC、5G數據機到AI基礎建設，已由終端裝置擴大到機櫃級系統。

天璣9600 Pro採台積電2奈米製程，使用2+3+3全大核CPU架構，配置2個4.55GHz超大核、3個4.35GHz大核與3個3.1GHz大核，快取記憶體容量達34.5MB，並支援LPDDR6與UFS5。效能數據上，單核較前代提升17%，多核提升15%，多核峰值功耗降低61%。AI運算則採雙NPU與Agentic AI Engine，NPU功耗降低40%。vivo X500 Pro系列已確定全球首發搭載天璣9600 Pro，首批採用天璣9600 Pro與天璣9600 M的智慧手機也將上市。

在通訊技術端，聯發科與愛立信完成商用5G網路上的GNSS RTK驗證，將RTK修正資料透過LTE定位協定送至終端，僅用裝置內建天線就把戶外定位誤差縮小到約30公分，若搭配測地級天線，可達公分級定位精準度。這項方案瞄準自動配送車、無人機、工業機器人與智慧港口等場景，終端則採聯發科最新5G數據機技術，可即時處理進階GNSS修正資訊。

聯發科在AI基礎建設則已納入NVIDIA NVLink Fusion生態系，協助客戶開發客製化AI加速器，涵蓋NVLink-C2C、高速I/O、HBM、先進封裝與機櫃級整合。2026年8月營收641.83億元，月增32%，年增44.08%，前8月營收4139.91億元，年增5.76%。第三季營收目標區間為1522億元至1598億元，資料中心營收預計2026年將超過20億美元。

news.Title: 美國50指數季度調整，統一美國50 ETF新兵聚焦AI、資安與半導體
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】指數編製機構ICE Data Indices公布NYSE美國50指數九月季度調整結果，本次成分股調整為七進七出。新增成分股以具備高成長潛力的AI受惠族群為主，包括Palo Alto Networks、CrowdStrike、Arista Networks、戴爾科技（Dell Technologies）、德州儀器（Texas Instruments）、科磊（KLA）及SanDisk，並剔除美國運通、麥當勞、林德集團、百事可樂、威訊通訊、IBM及T-Mobile US。本次成分股調整於9月21日生效，追蹤該指數的統一美國50 ETF(009811)，也將緊隨指數調整投資組合。統一投信表示，AI趨勢明確且需求強勁，為美股主旋律。本次美國50指數調整，圍繞AI發展所延伸受惠的各族群，包括資安、雲端基礎建設、AI硬體、半導體、記憶體。其中，Palo Alto Networks與CrowdStrike為全球資安產業領導者。在企業數位轉型及AI應用普及下，網路攻擊風險持續增加，資安需求具高度剛性，兩家公司皆擁有領先的資安市場地位及穩定成長動能，可望受惠於企業資安支出增加趨勢。

其次，Arista Networks與戴爾科技則是AI基礎建設的重要受惠者。統一投信表示，Arista在高速網路交換器市場具領先優勢。隨著大型雲端服務商持續擴建AI資料中心，基建相關需求有望保持強勁。而戴爾則透過AI伺服器及儲存設備，卡位企業AI基建市場，有機會受到企業AI設施建置浪潮帶動，營收及獲利成長潛力可期。SanDisk專注於NAND Flash及儲存解決方案，AI資料中心儲存需求成長，加上記憶體產業景氣循環回升，有利該公司營運。

統一投信表示，半導體作為數位化的硬體設備核心，受惠各產業與科技技術的結合。其中，德州儀器及科磊具備不同產業定位。德州儀器深耕類比IC市場，受惠工業及汽車電子長期成長趨勢；科磊為半導體製程控制與檢測設備領導廠商，掌握先進製程與晶片品質檢測關鍵技術，在AI晶片擴產中扮演重要角色。

統一投信表示，整體而言，本次新增個股兼具成長性與產業領導地位，不僅掌握AI與數位化趨勢，也提高美國50指數在資安、半導體及基礎建設領域的布局廣度，有助於強化長期競爭力與成長動能。統一美國50 ETF聚焦美股市值五十強企業，投資組合兼具成長和價值因子，不僅將尖牙股成長爆發力融為骨血，還涵蓋通訊、非核心消費、金融和醫療保健等八大產業，具備「穩中帶強、強中帶穩」特色。

009811追蹤之指數採取市值加權，並於每年的3、6、9、12月進行指數季調整定審。

news.Title: 美擬保留中國新藥授權空間，恆生生物科技指數一度大漲4%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】港股生技類股週一早盤集體逞強，恆生生物科技指數一度大漲4%，主要受到美國川普政府擬對中國生技投資採取較精準而非全面限制的消息激勵。華爾街見聞報導，市場解讀，新規若保留大部分中國新藥授權交易空間，有助降低中美醫藥合作遭全面切斷的政策風險。路透報導，美國財政部正起草針對藥廠投資中國的新規則，只要相關中國藥物或生技資產不涉及病原體，或不存在遭武器化的風險，美國藥廠仍可能獲准投資或取得授權。這項安排將與美國對半導體、電動車及其他敏感科技領域的對中投資限制形成差異，也比部分國會議員要求的全面管制更為寬鬆。

中國已成為全球創新藥物的重要來源。GlobalData統計，去年中國生技企業對外授權交易潛在總值達1,150億美元，2025年美國藥廠從海外引進授權藥物的交易中，近一半來自中國。今年百時美施貴寶(Bristol Myers Squibb，美股代碼BMY)與恆瑞醫藥(600276.SH)合作案最高價值達152億美元，輝瑞(Pfizer，美股代碼PFE)與信達生物(01801.HK)合作規模最高達105億美元，凸顯中國創新藥資產對全球大型藥廠的重要性。

輝瑞執行長艾伯特．布爾拉(Albert Bourla)等大型藥廠高層近期積極遊說川普政府，主張單純取得中國藥物授權並不構成國安風險；但美國部分中小型生技公司及國會議員仍要求收緊規範。相關規則尚未定案，且預計不會在本週川習會前公布；若最終採取「限制敏感技術、保留新藥授權」模式，可望維持中美醫藥交易管道，並成為港股創新藥及生技類股的重要政策利多。

news.Title: 蘇元和觀點》台股量縮錢去哪？8656億資金卡在漢測 為何38萬人搶申購？
news.Content:
[Newtalk新聞] 近期台股成交量明顯萎縮，表面上看似市場交投轉淡，實際上部分資金可能只是暫時轉向新股申購，引發市場熱議。漢測（7856）此次公開申購吸引38萬4717筆申購，以每股2,250元、每張225萬元計算，市場凍結資金約8656億元，最終合格申購件數為35萬3347件，中籤率約0.29%。如此龐大的短期資金沉澱，也成為近期「量縮」現象的一個特殊觀察點。

不過，若從投資角度觀察漢測，真正值得關注的並不是申購熱度，而是公司未來成長結構正在改變。

市場習慣將漢測歸類為探針卡相關公司，但從目前布局與公司公開說法來看，2026年至2027年的成長動能，除了既有探針卡業務，更值得關注熱管理模組與測試工程服務。高功耗熱管理是目前重要成長引擎，相關模組主要因應AI晶片高功耗所帶來的測試散熱需求。

這意味著漢測的商業模式不只是「賣探針卡」，而是逐步往產品＋工程服務＋設備的整合模式發展。測試設備裝機除了創造工程服務收入，也可能成為後續熱控模組、探針卡及其他測試設備切入客戶供應鏈的入口。

更值得注意的是，公司的新產品布局正逐步集中在2027年前後，包括CPO相關設備、回焊設備，以及薄膜與MEMS探針卡等。公司已公開說明，將持續切入CPO、先進封裝及高階測試相關設備市場。

因此，漢測真正值得追蹤的時間點，可能不是9月22日掛牌本身，而是2027年新產品能否從驗證走向量產與放量。

接下來市場應觀察幾項關鍵指標：新設備是否如期出貨、產能擴充能否與訂單匹配、熱控模組採用率是否提升，以及CPO、回焊設備與新世代探針卡能否形成實質營收。

換句話說，漢測的評價邏輯可能逐漸從「高價探針卡股」轉向「半導體測試整合方案供應商」。短期看掛牌與市場交易，中期則應回到營收組合、產品單價、客戶滲透率及新產品量產進度。

漢測真正的看點不只在探針卡，而是在「裝機服務→熱控模組→探針卡→先進封裝設備」能否形成完整的成長鏈。2026年看基本盤，2027年看新產品接棒，2028年則看放量成效。

news.Title: 台積電、聯發科、南亞科、華邦電 大摩看好台股23檔噴發
news.Content:
台灣持續在人工智慧熱潮中扮演要角，即便2028年的雲端服務供應商的資本支出成長幅度放緩，但外資券商摩根士丹利仍看好AI半導體供應鏈的年複合成長率達30%，並點名23檔台股個股，包括台積電、聯發科、南亞科及華邦電等受惠。

人工智慧基建浪潮趨緩 台股仍是主角？

綜合媒體報導，摩根士丹利預估，雲端服務供應商的總資本支出成長幅度將逐步收斂，相較於今年的99%，明年會下修至60%，2028年會降至12%。顯示人工智慧的投資從硬體基礎建設的暴增期，進入平穩期與變現驗收期。

即使如此，人工智慧半導體的整體潛在市場TAM仍被看好，預估2030年的規模將達到7530億美元，幾乎佔所有半導體市場的一半，若從樂觀情境來看，人工智慧半導體的的TAM規模能夠在今年達到4850億美元。

上中下游全面盤點 23檔受矚

在此背景下，台灣半導體供應鏈上中下游將全面受惠，大摩點名台積電、聯發科、日月光、世芯-KY、創意、信驊、南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、譜瑞-KY、大聯大、文曄、義隆、上詮、萬潤、鴻勁、家登、旺矽、穎崴、京元電子、力積電、聯電及旺矽等23檔。

涵蓋上中下游供應鏈，包括IC設計與IP、晶片製造、記憶體、封裝測試、關鍵設備與耗材，以及分銷通路等。

另外，大摩指出，輝達2027年營收預估成長70%，有利於台灣供應鏈發揮，預估全球DRAM持續供不應求，即使納入長江存儲的產能，2026年及2027年的供需缺口仍達-17%與-15%。即使如此，大摩仍提到潛在風險，包括成本上升擠壓毛利率，非人工智慧半導體領域的資源遭排擠等。

news.Title: 「四巫日」費半強升　聯發科5035元創新高領軍　台股溫和上漲逾4百點
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】中東葉門戰事升溫，伊朗向美國傳達重新開放荷姆茲海峽的條件，國際油價仍處相對高檔。台股上周資金漸回流，市場追價信心穩健。美股週五（18日）迎來「四巫日」，股票指數與個股期貨、選擇權同步面臨結算，四大主要指數漲跌互見，那指、標普小幅收高，道瓊跌近百點，費半漲2.78％，台北股市今天開盤溫和小漲，隨買盤加溫漲點擴大漲逾400點，早盤加權指數最高為47625點。

美股四大主要指數漲跌互見，台北股市今天開盤溫和小漲，隨買盤加溫漲點擴大漲逾400點，早盤加權指數最高為47625點（圖／Artlist）

台股周一主要由台積電、聯發科等大型權值股領軍撐盤，聯發科（2454）打破博通壟斷Google TPU供應商局面，成功拿下Google v8i與v9的TPU大單，聯發科首款AI加速器ASIC預計第四季進入量產，股價今日重回5千元大關，最高來到5035元創下歷史新高價。護國神山台積電（2330）開盤下跌15元至2445元，隨後翻紅上揚，早盤最高2485元。

本週川習會即將舉行，中美雙方將聚焦人工智慧對話、關稅戰延長及稀土供應等重要議題，成為台股投資人關注焦點。法人指出，上週台股資金持續回流，外資及陸資合計買超近870億元，市場追價信心穩健。

國際局勢方面，中東葉門戰事升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德遭飛彈攻擊，美國警告區域衝突恐快速擴大，伊朗則透過調解方向美方傳達解除封鎖荷莫茲海峽的條件。國際油價持續高檔，北海布倫特原油價格維持每桶100美元以上，增添市場不確定因素。

法人提醒投資人重點是中秋連假前台股能否維持日均成交量逾新台幣兆元水準，以及電子權值股能否延續多頭態勢。台指期夜盤小幅下跌，顯示短線觀望氣氛濃厚，建議密切關注川習會後市場反應。

news.Title: Neocloud Boom: Comparing Nebius, CoreWeave, & IREN
news.Content:
The AI Buildout is Accelerating

The current artificial intelligence buildout is the largest industrial buildout since the railroad boom in the 1800s. America's leading big tech companies are spending hundreds of billions of dollars to capture their piece of the fastest-growing industry since the internet in the late 1990s. In 2026, AI hyperscalers Microsoft ( MSFT ), Alphabet ( GOOGL ), Meta Platforms ( META ) , Amazon ( AMZN ), and Oracle ( ORCL ) are expected to spend ~$700 billion on AI infrastructure CAPEX. By 2027, these hyperscalers are expected to spend a mind-boggling $729 billion in CAPEX. Much of that CAPEX spend is going to data centers, high-powered semiconductors, and energy.

What is a Neocloud?

Currently, much investor attention is focused on who will win the battle among frontier model labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. However, OpenAI and Anthropic have yet to IPO, and when they do, their valuations are likely to be sky-high. Nevertheless, instead of picking winners in the frontier space, investors can focus on the "picks and shovels" plays driving the AI boom.

Neoclouds are specialized cloud computing providers that rent the high-performance graphics processing units (GPUs) required to power artificial intelligence. These neoclouds differ from legacy cloud providers because they focus solely on delivering the compute needed for AI. Neoclouds have two major advantages over legacy cloud providers – they are less expensive than traditional cloud providers, and they require no hardware ownership (allowing tech firms to scale AI models without purchasing their own physical infrastructure).

Which Neocloud is the Best Investment?

Three of the main publicly traded neoclouds are Nebius Group ( NBIS ), IREN ( IREN ), and CoreWeave ( CRWV ). The three leading neocloud providers share several similarities. For instance, each has a multi-year partnership with leading semiconductor company NVIDIA ( NVDA ). Additionally, the three companies have landed multi-billion-dollar contracts in recent months. However, investors must understand the key differences. For example, stock performance varies widely. Over the past year, Nebius is up 109.70%, IREN is up 11.50%, and CoreWeave is down 38.90%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Why is Nebius Outperforming IREN & CoreWeave?

Although all the neoclouds are growing rapidly, Nebius is growing the fastest. Zacks Consensus Estimates suggest Nebius will grow revenue a blistering 530.09% in 2026 (vs. 151% for CRWV & 346% for IREN).

Story Continues

Despite the lightning-fast top-line growth, the leading neoclouds are likely to remain unprofitable for the foreseeable future, as the costs for real estate, data centers, and cutting-edge GPUs are frontloaded. As a result, Nebius, CoreWeave, and IREN must rely heavily on debt financing.

Neoclouds: Pay Attention to Debt Interest

Not all neocloud debt is created equal. CoreWeave is currently paying 8.3% interest on its debt while Nebius pays 2.3% and IREN pays 1.7%. While IREN appears to have an advantage over Nebius on the surface, investors must exercise apply nuance. IREN's debt is largely funded by converts, which created dilution. Conversely, Nebius has been able to receive a large portion of the capital needed upfront in its recent contract wins.

Finally, with $8.04 billion in cash on hand, Nebius is better capitalized than IREN ($5.9B in cash) and CoreWeave ($5.52B in cash).

Bottom Line

As the AI infrastructure buildout accelerates, investors are looking beyond frontier model labs. Neocloud providers offer compelling "picks and shovels" investments, but not all are created equal.

news.Title: 9月國民經濟信心 看好GDP破11% 台股樂觀指數大增
news.Content:
國泰金控發布2026年9月國民經濟信心調查，調查顯示，民眾的景氣樂觀指數反彈，其中景氣現況樂觀指數上升至14.8，展望樂觀指數上升至16.5；股市樂觀情緒及風險偏好指數也同步回升，樂觀指數回升至49.1，風險偏好指數上升至32.9。

景氣樂觀情緒回暖

國發會最新公布的7月景氣對策信號續呈紅燈，領先指標及同時指標續呈上升，景氣仍呈穩健成長。本月調查顯示，民眾的景氣樂觀指數反彈，其中景氣現況樂觀指數上升至14.8，展望樂觀指數上升至16.5。消費意願也同步改善，其中大額消費意願指數升至18.3，耐久財消費意願指數升至-3.9。

52%民眾預期2026年GDP高於11%

主計總處於2026年8月14日預估台灣2026年經濟成長率11.05%，通貨膨脹率2.07%。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於2026年經濟成長率的平均預期值為10.89%，有52%的民眾認為2026年經濟成長率會高於11%；而民眾對於2026年平均通膨預期值為2.51%，且有高達51%的民眾認為2026年通貨膨脹率會高於2.5%。相較於主計總處，民眾對於2026年的經濟成長預估與主計總處接近，但通膨預期依舊較高。

股市樂觀情緒及風險偏好指數回升

雖然美伊談判持續，不過美國通膨數據未大幅上升、且四大雲端服務供應商（CSP）續上修資本支出，財報優於預期支撐AI基本面，帶動台股走升，本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於台股的樂觀指數回升至49.1，風險偏好指數上升至32.9。

79%民眾預期通膨率大於2%

關於民眾對一年後通貨膨脹率看法的調查，本月的調查結果顯示：79%的民眾預期一年以後通貨膨脹率大於2%，其中35%民眾預期將大於3%。另外，15%民眾覺得一年以後通貨膨脹率介於1%至2%。

此外，有35%民眾認為未來一年物價漲跌主要受到日常消費價格影響（外食、蔬菜水果、民生日用品等），另有29%民眾認為進口原物料價格（原油、鋼鐵等），是未來一年物價漲跌判斷的主要因素。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉台積電翻紅拉高 聯發科、PCB領軍上攻 漲逾400點穩步挑戰4萬8
news.Content:
AI題材動能延續，但國際油價仍處高檔，美股四大指數上周五(18日)漲跌互現。台積電今(21)日早盤翻紅拉高，但聯發科力挺撐盤，早盤以47207.3點開高走高，盤中漲逾400點，最高衝上47596.14點，穩步挑戰4萬8，預估全日成交量9000億元。

觀察電子權值股今天表現，台積電(2330-TW)以2445元開低後，盤中翻紅漲至2485元，帶領台股穩步上攻，鴻海(2317-TW)於平盤附近震盪，不過聯發科(2454-TW)漲勢凌厲，大漲逾半根停板。另外，台達電(2308-TW)漲逾1%，日月光(3711-TW)漲逾3%，聯電(2303-TW)及廣達(2382-TW)則小跌。

受惠AI GPU與ASIC伺服器需求強勁，ABF載板三雄今天紛紛走揚，欣興(3037-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)大漲逾半根停板，南電(8046-TW)漲逾4%。此外，也帶動PCB族群上揚，聯茂(6213-TW)漲逾半根停板， 金像電(2368-TW)、臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)也有超過1%漲幅。

友達(2409-TW)已布局先進封裝領域，且傳出台積電與其洽談廠房交易，雙方有可能進一步合作，激勵友達大漲逾半根停板，在友達領軍下，彩晶(6116-TW)與群創(3481-TW)1至2%的漲幅。而富采(3714-TW)加碼持股友達超過7萬張持股，富采今天也漲逾2%。

美股四大指數上周五漲跌互現，道瓊指數下跌95.4點或0.18%，收51682.64；那斯達克指數上漲104.25點或0.4%，收26522.55點；S&P 500指數上漲12.74點或0.17%，收7650.5點；費城半導體指數上漲322.19點或2.78%，收11921.69點。

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股漲逾400點站上47600點 分析師李世新示警追高賣壓
news.Content:
美股四大指數漲多跌少，激勵台股今（21）日開高走高，加權指數以47,207.3點、上漲26.55點開出後漲勢擴大，盤中一度勁揚逾400點、最高觸及47,600.5點。豐銀投顧分析師李世新表示，市場資金由防禦型金融股轉向攻擊型電子股屬正向輪動，不過47,500點以上賣壓將逐步浮現，指數一路以最高點作收的機率不高。

今日值班分析師：豐銀投顧分析師 李世新

李世新指出，美國聯準會日前升息1碼符合市場預期，後續關鍵仍在原油價格。若油價能夠回落，聯準會升息步調有機會放緩，加上第四季向來有法人年底作帳行情，今年又適逢美國期中選舉年，依照過往經驗，選舉年的第四季通常是股市表現較佳的季度；上一次期中選舉年為2022年，當年股市也是進入第四季後才逐漸好轉。

盤面方面，今日資金主軸明確集中在電子股，聯發科、國巨、台達電及ABF載板等族群領軍上攻，聯發科盤中漲幅一度逼近7%，台積電開低震盪後勁揚25元。李世新分析，半導體、IC設計、半導體測試、設備、矽光子及光通訊仍是相對強勢族群，友達帶動面板及Micro LED題材升溫，太陽能族群也突然轉強，可能與市場重新關注馬斯克對太陽能產業長期發展的看法有關。

至於前幾日表現強勢的金融股，今日可能因資金排擠而出現回檔，但李世新認為，投資人不必過度緊張，資金由具有防守性質的金融股轉向攻擊型電子股，屬於有利多頭延續的健康輪動。雖然台積電並非今日領漲主力，但資金擴散至IC設計、面板、Micro LED及半導體測試等族群，也顯示市場仍具有一定追價動能。

指數方面，李世新預估，台股今日終場維持約300點漲幅仍可期待，但隨著指數持續墊高，賣壓也將逐步浮現，一路收在最高點的機率不大。47,500點為短線首道壓力，47,500點至48,000點之間的套牢與獲利了結賣壓較重，需要時間及量能消化；今日成交值估落在9,900億元至1.05兆元，可能略低於上周五，反映投資人接近前波高點後追價轉趨謹慎。

news.Title: 高盛：美企盈利成長有AI與經濟支撐，「盈利泡沫」疑慮被誇大
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，高盛集團方面表示，美國企業盈利大幅成長背後有強勁經濟前景和人工智能熱潮支撐，市場關於「盈利泡沫」的擔憂有所誇大。金融媒體行業研究匯總的數據顯示，標普500指數成分股企業今年前兩個季度利潤均成長約30%，屬於有記錄以來最強勁的表現之一。全年盈利成長預期則是2021年疫情後經濟反彈以來最高。

雖然這一增速表明，隨著AI投資激增，企業盈利可能正處於高於可持續水準的狀態，但以Ben Snider為首的高盛策略分析師團隊預計，未來幾年利潤增速將逐漸放緩，而不是出現直接崩塌。

Snider在報告中指出，當前市場定價已經計入盈利持續成長的預期，但投資者對於目前盈利能力的可持續性仍保持審慎。

美股8月創下紀錄高點後表現不振，主要受到通膨擔憂拖累。儘管分析師上調盈利預測，標普500指數估值仍有所下降。金融媒體行業研究數據顯示，目前市場共識仍是預計標普500企業利潤將在2027年和2028年分別成長19%和17%。

高盛對明年的預測略顯謹慎，預計盈利成長11%。該策略團隊認為，儘管資本支出仍將上升，但AI投資對盈利的推動作用將從2027年開始減弱。Snider還預計，與半導體相關企業的利潤率擴張速度明年也將放緩。

Snider預計，未來一年標普500指數將上漲14%，至約8,700點，主要推動力將來自盈利成長而非估值擴張。今年年初，他曾是對美股前景較為樂觀的策略師之一，並準確預計強勁盈利和AI應用將抵消油價上漲和升息的影響，使牛市得以延續。

與此同時，包括Jared Woodard和Michael Hartnett在內的美國銀行策略分析師警告，考慮到盈利成長前景將放緩，投資者目前的倉位仍過於樂觀。美國銀行引述EPFR Global數據稱，美國股票基金單週吸引近640億美元資金流入，為三個月來最大規模。

今日盤勢及未來走勢：(留意CCL布局機會)

週五美股尾盤傳出 Anthropic 營收大幅成長的消息，進一步提振市場對 AI 產業需求的信心，帶動科技股走強，美股終場漲多跌少，幅度介於-0.18%至2.78%，台積電ADR上漲1.02%，台指期夜盤下跌23點，估今日台股開於平盤附近，盤中科技權值股或有買盤湧入，挹注指數再創波段新高。

短線觀點：雖週四加權指數開高走低、留下長上影線，惟終場仍成功站回月線，多方重新取得盤面主導權；週五指數進一步展開反攻，不僅一舉收復所有短中期均線，成交量亦重新回到兆元水準，顯示市場追價動能與資金信心同步回溫。整體而言，短線多方格局再度轉強，若今日出現量縮拉回，且重要均線與前波突破區未遭跌破，反而可視為良性整理，提供逢回布局機會。

操作看法：近期市場傳出AI伺服器CCL可能降低規格的雜音，導致相關個股一度出現集體修正；惟就產業趨勢來看，AI伺服器對高階CCL需求仍維持強勁，整體供需結構尚未明顯轉弱，考量短線利空情緒已有所反映，後續可留意相關個股的拉回逢低布局機會。

重點產業與族群：

CCL – 2383台光電、6213聯茂、6274台燿

產業觀點：AI 伺服器持續朝高速傳輸與高層數 PCB 發展，推升 CCL需求快速成長。Rubin 平台新增 CX-9等高價值板卡，使每櫃高階 CCL 價值較 GB300 大幅提升，帶動高階CCL 供應商迎來新一波成長契機。

news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

受到美債殖利率回檔、國際油價同步降溫的激勵，加上台灣央行決議維持利率不變，並適度放寬房市信用管制，激勵台股大盤以46,449點紅盤開出後，多方氣勢如虹，呈現「開高走高收最高」的強勁格局。終場狂飆892點，收在47,180點，一舉收復各均線關卡。更關鍵的是，成交量能放大至1.07兆元的水準，呈現標準的量價齊揚攻擊型態。權值股方面，台積電上漲1.44%、鴻海收平盤、聯發科上漲4.66%、廣達下跌0.29%，台達電上漲2.96%。盤面強勢股，創意、京元電子、貿聯-KY、矽格、欣銓、華星光、宏致、致茂、倉和、精測等漲停；南亞科、穩懋、鴻勁、世芯-KY、大立光、頎邦、群聯、雙鴻、奇鋐、富喬等漲幅6%以上。盤面弱勢股，中湛跌停；和益、揚博、亞通、光焱科技、宣德、益航等跌幅5%以上。終場台灣加權指數上漲892.75點，以47180.75點作收，成交量1.07兆元。三大類股漲跌互見，電子上漲2.44%、傳產上漲0.57%、金融下跌0.96%。在次族群部份以綠能環保、光電、電子零組件表現較佳，分別上漲3.75%、3.33%、3.26%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計買超1194.51億元。其中外資買超869.94億元，投信買超81.53億元，自營商買超243.03億元。外資買超前五大為力積電、華邦電、南亞科、聯電、京元電子；賣超前五大為友達、臺企銀、群創、玉山金、和益。投信買超前五大為聯電、長榮航、藥華藥、廣達、興富發；賣超前五大為國泰金、元大金、兆豐金、華南金、力成。資券變化方面，融資增46.42億元，融資餘額為5940.39億元，融券增0.67萬張，融券餘額為22.3萬張。外資台指期部位，空單減少2521口，淨空單部位76110口，借券賣出金額381.96億元。成交比重：電子86.04%、傳產9.22%、金融4.74%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

烏克蘭無人機大規模襲擊莫斯科煉油廠引發火災、10年期美債殖利率維持高檔震盪，壓抑美股道瓊指數走跌95.4點；所幸美國晶片股延續強勁漲勢，南韓研調報告預估今年全球半導體市場將翻倍達1.6兆美元且記憶體供應緊俏至明年，帶動科技板塊走揚。費半指數大漲2.78%，台積電ADR上漲1.0%。此外，川普宣布將成立「AI部隊」力保技術領先，美中高層亦展開「川習會」前會談聚焦AI模型與關鍵礦物，進一步鞏固科技產業多頭架構。

整體預估指數震盪盤堅。

台股後市分析如下：

第一、美國財政部長貝森特、貿易代表葛里爾於上週末在紐約會晤中國副總理何立峰，為9月24日「川習會」預先談判，雙方聚焦開放/封閉權重AI模型規範、稀土磁鐵供應及延長關稅休戰協議。

第二、2026台灣創新技術博覽會於17日登場，工研院展示「3.2T矽光子光引擎技術」，傳輸容量較前一代1.6T提升一倍，並已串聯晶片設計、製程、測試與封裝等上下游者，卡位AI資料中心高速傳輸需求。

第三、技術面觀察，週五大盤拉出一根扎實的實體長紅K棒，顯示多方主力控盤企圖心強烈。指標方面，短線指標KD與RSI雙雙在相對低檔形成黃金交叉、同步向上發散；同時，中波段指標MACD的綠色柱狀體亦大幅縮小，顯示指標全面共振翻揚，奠定了短多續攻的堅實基礎。

第四、盤面資金聚焦IC設計、封測、資安軟體等個股，包括創意、達發、京元電子、矽格、華經、驊宏資等表現強勢。

【投資策略】：

俄烏地緣衝突升溫，能源價格波動，惟上週全球央行周及美、日升息後，美國十年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂及繼續升息的緊張情緒。台股受惠AI算力推論需求爆發、外資單日大幅買超869億元，強勢推升上周五指數突破47,100點，台股技術面重新翻多。本週除有台灣外銷訂單公佈外，今日那斯達克指數季度調整生效，多方題材充沛可望支撐買盤，預期大盤高檔震盪盤堅、操作建議擇優布局流動性佳的中大型AI權值股，及業績題材股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、銅箔基板、光傳輸、散熱、貨櫃散裝、特用化學及高殖利率銀行及壽險股等。

news.Title: 高度依賴台積電製程＋傳Q4晶片漲價10%，AMD股價上週五收高2.7%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】市場傳出超微(AMD，美股代碼AMD)計畫自2026年第四季起調高旗下多數晶片產品售價約10%，以反映台積電晶圓代工成本上升。供應鏈管道消息指出，調價範圍包括AI加速晶片、消費級GPU及主板晶片組，Ryzen CPU雖尚未被明確列入，但因同樣高度依賴台積電先進製程，後續價格仍存在上調可能。AMD尚未正式確認相關漲價計畫。消息傳出後，AMD上週五(18日)終場漲14.73美元或2.70%，收在559.82美元，接近日高559.91美元，顯示市場對成本轉嫁能力與AI需求韌性仍抱持正面反應。

報導指出，此波調價可能與台積電晶圓代工報價上調約10%有關。AMD旗下AI加速器、GPU及多數CPU均大量採用台積電製程，若晶圓成本全面上升，將直接侵蝕毛利率；在AI數據中心需求仍強勁情況下，AMD選擇將成本向下游轉嫁，也反映AI晶片供應商目前仍具一定定價能力。

另一方面，英特爾(Intel，美股代碼INTC)亦傳將自10月5日起再次調高PC CPU價格約10%，為2025年底以來第三輪漲價。英特爾上週五(18日)股價在前一日大漲7.67%後稍作整理，收跌0.20美元或0.18%，報108.60美元。若AMD與英特爾後續均落實漲價，伺服器與PC品牌廠將同時面臨CPU、GPU、記憶體與SSD等零組件價格上升壓力，成本傳導可能進一步向整機與終端市場擴散。

news.Title: 台積電先進封裝驗證平台動土，紓解CoWoS與2奈米擴產壓力？
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-21 08:35:34 數位內容中心 發佈

- 台積電將於高雄白埔園區興建佔地約3公頃的先進封裝設備驗證平台，設置兩棟建物，導入「mini-loop」模組化驗證線與小型潔淨室，目標將設備驗證回饋時間縮短25%至50%，加快量產驗證與設備導入。[1][2]

- 目前更關鍵的限制仍在工具交付與調試，以及2奈米良率帶來的產能與毛利稀釋風險；此外，CoWoS產能仍落後市場需求約三成，封裝短缺也不是單一驗證平台能立即消除的問題。[3][4][5]

- 接下來可觀察首波進駐廠商名單、設備安裝節奏、驗證中心正式投用時程，以及CoWoS與先進封裝出貨是否因此明顯回升。[2][3][6]

台積電21日將在高雄白埔動土興建一座先進封裝設備驗證平台，這也是台積電首度在台灣設置此類專門設施。公司規劃以約3公頃用地興建兩棟建物，內含「mini-loop」模組化製程驗證線、小型潔淨室與供應商共同開發空間，宣稱可把過去以週、月計的驗證回饋時間大幅縮短，進一步加快設備從安裝到量產的導入速度。[1][2]

白埔驗證平台瞄準封裝設備導入痛點

台積電將這座驗證平台定位為解決封裝後段「設備—材料—製程整合」痛點的設施。公司先進封裝單位指出，AI帶動CoWoS與多晶片整合需求快速成長，但後段設備商的規模與研發資源普遍不如前段設備業者；透過平台化、群體式驗證，可讓設備廠在進入量產工廠前，先完成硬體、軟體與製程整合，減少跨國往返驗證的時間成本，也能在場內即時修改、重新驗證，縮短回饋週期。[1][2]

業界與媒體評估，若平台如期發揮效益，除了可縮短個別設備導入時間，也可望帶動本土設備與檢測廠接單，像是具備貼合、點膠與光學量測能力的萬潤，以及G2C+聯盟成員，都可能受惠於先進封裝擴產。這座平台也被視為供應鏈加速器，有助供應商更快跟上客戶量產驗收節奏，間接緩解CoWoS與高階封裝的交期瓶頸。[1][2][7][8]

CoWoS 與 2 奈米瓶頸不只卡在驗證平台

不過，白埔驗證平台並非萬靈丹。市場資料指出，台積電CoWoS產能目前仍落後市場需求約三成，短期內難以完全補上；更核心、也更難快速突破的瓶頸，仍在工具交付與調試，以及2奈米製程本身的良率提升。2奈米與背面供電等製程複雜度高，牽涉更多研磨、減薄與金屬化步驟，任何工具延遲或調試問題，都會直接影響產能擴張節奏與良率。[3][4]

此外，台積電本業正進行史上大規模擴張，已將全年資本支出上修至600億至640億美元，以支援2奈米放量與全球擴產計畫；管理層也預告，2奈米量產將帶來短期毛利稀釋，需靠生產效率與產能最佳化抵銷。市場也開始討論先進製程與封裝漲價，基本漲幅預期落在5%至10%，超配額追加訂單可能另有溢價，這些資本與價格訊號都將影響半導體客戶的採購策略與成本結構。[9][5][10]

白埔驗證平台的實際效果，仍取決於幾個環節能否同步到位，包括設備商交付能力、在地測試與調試團隊擴編速度，以及材料與檢測供應鏈的配套成熟度。若平台確實能明顯縮短設備從安裝到量產的時間，並協助供應鏈更快通過量產驗證，白埔才有機會從驗證加速器，進一步成為緩解CoWoS供需缺口的重要節點。[8]

短期內，市場首先可觀察的是哪些廠商會率先進駐、驗證中心建置進度與交付時程，以及台積電何時對外公布正式投用時間。至於能否進一步反映在CoWoS與先進封裝出貨回升，仍有待首批設備安裝與初次量產驗證結果出爐。[2][3][6]

news.Title: Bill Ackman Built a $2.4 Billion Stake in Microsoft, Calling It a "Core Holding" Bought at a "Highly Compelling Valuation." Here's Why He's Betting Big on Big Tech.
news.Content:
Earlier this year, Pershing Square (NYSE: PS) founder and CEO Bill Ackman piled into a stock well-known not only to tech investors, but the general public at large: Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT).

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

This demonstrates the famous investor's bullish outlook on the tech sector, as four slots in the company's limited equity portfolio are held by prominent tech names (or at least heavily tech-slanted, in the case of rideshare king Uber Technologies ). Here's why Ackman and his team are so drawn to the sector these days.

A macro buy of Microsoft

Pershing Square's Microsoft move became public knowledge in May, and like most of the company's buy-ins, it was a doozy. The company bought more than 5.65 million shares, worth nearly $2.1 billion as of the end of March.

Subsequently, shifting its tech allocation, Pershing Square sold its relatively small holding in Google parent Alphabet to load up on a bit more Microsoft. This brought the company's holding in the Windows maker to slightly over 6.2 million shares as of the end of June, worth $2.3 billion.

Leaning into tech has been a key plank in Pershing Square's investment strategy of late. The quartet of sector stocks the company held at the end of last year -- Alphabet, Uber, Meta Platforms , and Amazon -- accounted for 40% of the portfolio in dollar terms.

Ackman's letter to shareholders covering Pershing Square's inaugural quarter as a publicly traded company explained the reasons. He took pains to note that in the first half of this year, two of the 24 industry groups comprising S&P 500 index components were responsible for 85% of the index's year-to-date gains -- semiconductors and IT hardware, foundational members of the broad tech sector.

Squaring with the strategy

In that letter, Ackman also enumerated Pershing Square's core investment principles. The company is always on the lookout for stocks that "are simple, predictable, and free cash flow-generative, with strong competitive positions, minimal financial leverage and capital markets dependency, and are run by excellent management teams."

While I'm not convinced all of that applies to every one of the four tech holdings, I'd say the better large companies in the sector tick each box, Microsoft included.

So is Ackman's current faith in tech justified? I would say so.

Story Continues

After all, the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, despite its fits and starts, continues to intensify and looks basically unstoppable (despite the recent gloomy pronouncements of several high-profile developers). Also, the ever-increasing utility of tech solutions for all manner of users, from the individual to the most influential global company, will keep customer demand high.

And, at the center of it all will be the tried, tested, and tenacious U.S. tech industry. Barring some catastrophic meltdown, then, I'd expect habitual buy-and-holder Pershing Square to keep a tight grip on its current sector holdings for a while, perhaps adding one or a few names in coming quarters. Ackman and company are basically tech-heads these days.

news.Title: Amazon (AMZN)’s Debut Sterling Bond Sale Prices Bigger, But Demand Cools from Alphabet’s
news.Content:
On September 9, 2026, Reuters reported that Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) raised £4.25 billion, or about $5.76 billion, in its first-ever sterling bond sale, slightly more than initially expected, as part of a four-tranche deal spanning 3 to 19 years. Final investor demand came in at more than £10.65 billion, roughly 2.5 times the amount raised, but that was notably lower than the demand Alphabet saw for its own sterling debut in February, a sign analysts said shows hyperscaler borrowing may be starting to test the limits of investor appetite.

Bull Case

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN )'s first sterling bond sale shows that investors still have a strong appetite for its debt. The firm raised $5.8 billion through the offering, and demand reached roughly 2.5 times the amount available. The sterling market also has relatively limited supply of large technology-company debt. It could back up demand for future Amazon issuance in the currency. Strong demand gives Amazon another funding channel as it finances its large-scale AI and cloud infrastructure investments.

Amazon can put the proceeds toward AWS, its fastest-growing major business. AWS revenue increased 36.7% year over year in the second quarter. It marks its fastest growth rate in 18 quarters as demand for AI infrastructure accelerated. Funding more data centers, computing capacity and related infrastructure could allow Amazon to capture more of that demand. If AWS sustains its growth while making strong operating profits, the additional debt could support investments in one of Amazon's most important long-term earnings drivers.

The sterling offering diversifies Amazon's funding base as its capital requirements grow. Amazon issued four tranches with maturities ranging from three to 19 years. It gives the business access to UK investors while adding sterling financing alongside its existing dollar, euro, Swiss franc and yen debt. This overall investor base gives Amazon greater flexibility to raise capital across different markets and currencies. So diversification could become more valuable as Amazon funds an unprecedented AI infrastructure buildout without relying entirely on one debt market.

Bear Case

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN )'s weaker reception compared with Alphabet signals that investors may demand higher borrowing costs from hyperscalers. Amazon's sterling offering attracted about 2.5 times coverage, below Alphabet's roughly 3.5 times coverage for its recent euro bond sale. The difference shows that demand for hyperscaler debt is not unlimited. If investor appetite continues to weaken, Amazon could face higher yields on future borrowing, increasing the cost of financing its AI infrastructure expansion.

Story Continues

Amazon's debt issuance comes as its cash generation faces increasing pressure from its AI spending. The firm reported a $7.6 billion trailing free-cash-flow outflow. It also expects capital expenditures of roughly $220 billion in 2026. Therefore, extra borrowing adds interest and refinancing obligations while Amazon commits enormous amounts of capital to data centers and AI infrastructure. Investors need Amazon's investments to make enough incremental operating profit and cash flow to justify the rising financing burden.

The hyperscaler debt boom could raise financing costs across the technology sector. The European Central Bank has warned that hyperscalers' aggressive borrowing could crowd out other companies in credit markets and push up funding costs. Amazon faces this pressure while it competes with Alphabet, Microsoft, and other technology companies for enormous amounts of capital to finance AI infrastructure. A sustained growth in debt-market competition could raise Amazon's cost of capital and reduce the returns it earns on its massive AI investments.

Hedge Fund Sentiment

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) remains Insider Monkey's most widely held stock, with 369 hedge funds holding a stake in the second quarter, up from 353 in the first, and position value rising to $97.10 billion from $77.61 billion. Alphabet, whose stronger sterling deal set the bar Amazon fell short of, saw an even sharper increase in conviction, with holders climbing to 275 from 265 and position value jumping to $93.74 billion from $72.41 billion.

Conclusion

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN )'s $5.8 billion sterling bond sale gives the company another source of funding for its aggressive AI and AWS expansion while demonstrating that investors continue to absorb large amounts of Amazon debt. Nonetheless, weaker demand than Alphabet's recent offering, rising industry-wide borrowing, and Amazon's $7.6 billion free-cash-flow outflow show the financial risks of funding a roughly $220 billion capital-spending plan. Amazon needs its AI and AWS investments to make enough incremental earnings and cash flow to justify the extra debt and rising cost of capital.

news.Title: Amazon (AMZN) Sued Again, This Time over How it Treats Pregnant Warehouse Workers
news.Content:
On September 8, 2026, Reuters reported that Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) was sued in a proposed nationwide class action accusing the company of systematically discriminating against thousands of pregnant employees, including by denying basic accommodations like chairs and bathroom breaks and firing workers who missed too much time for pregnancy-related medical needs.

The lawsuit was filed in Brooklyn federal court by nonprofit worker-advocacy group A Better Balance on behalf of four former warehouse employees. It comes 11 months after New Jersey sued Amazon on similar grounds and follows a comparable New York lawsuit filed in 2022.

Photo by Bryan Angelo on Unsplash

Bull Case

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) has a strong defense against the lawsuit's claim of systematic discrimination. The company says it provides pregnancy-related accommodations to tens of thousands of employees each year and approved more than 99.9% of requests in the past year. That response gives Amazon a basis to challenge the plaintiffs' broader characterization of its workplace practices as systematic discrimination.

Amazon's scale and profitability can cushion the financial impact of the litigation. The company generated $27.5 billion in operating income in the second quarter, up 43% year over year. Total sales rose 20% to $200.6 billion. Even if the lawsuit produces financial penalties or higher compliance costs, Amazon's earnings base gives it substantial capacity to absorb those expenses.

Potential changes to federal pregnancy-workplace rules could improve Amazon's legal position. The EEOC plans to propose changes to regulations governing the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act in November. Its chair has previously argued that the current regulations go too far. If the agency narrows the rules, Amazon could gain more legal support as it defends the lawsuit and manages similar claims.

Bear Case

The lawsuit adds to a growing pattern of pregnancy and disability claims against Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ). New Jersey sued Amazon in 2025 over alleged discrimination against pregnant and disabled warehouse workers. New York filed a similar case in 2022. The new nationwide class action could therefore make it harder for Amazon to treat the allegations as isolated incidents and could increase legal and compliance costs.

The proposed nationwide class action creates overall reputational risk. Four former warehouse employees accuse Amazon of denying basic accommodations and firing workers who exceeded time-off limits. One plaintiff alleges that Amazon warned her about termination one day after a pregnancy-related hospitalization and fired her five days later. Such allegations could damage Amazon's reputation as an employer and increase pressure to change warehouse policies.

Story Continues

The New Jersey case's progress could increase Amazon's litigation exposure. A New Jersey state court rejected Amazon's request to dismiss that lawsuit on July 31. It allows the case to continue. That outcome increases the likelihood of further discovery, legal expenses, and scrutiny of Amazon's workplace practices while the company also defends the new nationwide action.

Hedge Fund Sentiment

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN )'s hedge fund following grew to 369 funds in the second quarter from 353 in the first, with position value rising to $97.10 billion from $77.61 billion, according to Insider Monkey's database, the largest institutional following of any stock it tracks. Walmart, the only larger U.S. private employer and a company that has faced its own worker-treatment litigation, saw hedge fund holders increase to 111 from 99, with position value rising to $11.12 billion from $10.94 billion.

Conclusion

Amazon's strong profitability and its stated record of approving pregnancy-related accommodations should help it manage the financial risk from the lawsuit. But the nationwide class action, the continuing New Jersey case, and repeated allegations against its warehouse practices could increase legal costs and pressure Amazon to strengthen workplace policies. The company can absorb the immediate financial impact, but an overall pattern of litigation could create more real long-term reputational and compliance risks for investors.

news.Title: Investigators Dig into Landing Speed and Runway Safety After Amazon (AMZN)’s Fatal Miami Crash
news.Content:
On September 7, 2026, the Wall Street Journal reported that federal investigators are examining the landing speed, braking systems, and weather conditions of a fatal Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) cargo plane crash in Miami.

They are also checking whether runway safeguards worked properly and reviewing the contract between Amazon and flight operator 21 Air. Video of the landing appears to show the Boeing 767 remaining airborne well past the normal touchdown zone before crashing, and the National Transportation Safety Board said the plane careened roughly 1,300 feet off the runway before stopping.

Bull Case

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN )'s limited direct role in the aircraft operation could reduce its immediate legal exposure. The Miami cargo flight operated under Amazon Air by 21 Air, a third-party carrier, rather than by Amazon itself. This structure could limit Amazon's direct liability if investigators attribute the crash to pilot actions, aircraft systems, or carrier-level safety failures.

Amazon's strongest growth businesses remain largely insulated from the crash. Amazon reported second-quarter net sales of $200.6 billion, up 20% year over year. AWS revenue jumped 37% to $42.2 billion, its fastest growth in 18 quarters. These results show that AWS, advertising, and other major businesses are driving Amazon's financial performance regardless of the incident involving one contracted cargo carrier.

The ongoing investigation gives Amazon time to address any operational concerns. The NTSB continues to examine aircraft speed, mechanical systems, crew training, weather, air-traffic control, and runway safeguards. Investigators also review Amazon's contractual relationship with 21 Air. Amazon can use the findings to reassess carrier oversight and make targeted changes before the investigation produces any broader financial consequences.

Bear Case

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) could face greater legal and reputational exposure if investigators identify weaknesses in its oversight. The NTSB's review of Amazon's contractual relationship with 21 Air creates a risk that investigators could examine Amazon's role beyond simply hiring a third-party carrier. Any finding that Amazon's requirements or oversight contributed to the accident could increase legal costs and damage confidence in Amazon's delivery network.

The crash could force Amazon to increase spending on cargo safety and carrier oversight. Investigators are examining the aircraft's speed, braking systems, crew training, and runway safeguards. Recent findings show that the aircraft did not deploy its speed brakes or thrust reversers before the crash. If the investigation leads Amazon to solidify carrier requirements or safety procedures, the company could face higher logistics costs.

Story Continues

Amazon's heavy AI investment leaves less room for more cash outlays. Amazon's trailing-12-month free cash flow fell to a $7.6 billion outflow as capital spending on property and equipment rose sharply, mainly because of AI investments. Although Amazon expects those investments to support future growth, additional litigation, safety, or logistics costs from the crash could add pressure to near-term cash flow.

Hedge Fund Sentiment

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) remains the single most widely held stock in Insider Monkey's database, with 369 hedge funds holding a stake in the second quarter, up from 353 in the first, and combined position value climbing to $97.10 billion from $77.61 billion. FedEx, a comparably scaled air-cargo operator, moved in the opposite direction, with hedge fund holders slipping to 81 from 86 and position value falling to $4.20 billion from $5.32 billion.

Conclusion

Amazon's limited role in operating the aircraft should help contain its direct exposure to the crash. Strong growth in AWS and its broader businesses gives the company financial resilience. However, any finding that links Amazon's contractual oversight to the accident could increase legal costs, reputational pressure, and logistics expenses. Hence, the investigation creates a manageable near-term risk, but its findings could have broader implications for Amazon's air-cargo operations and shareholder returns.

news.Title: Streaming’s Biggest Rivals Just Became Allies in Washington
news.Content:
Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX ), Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ), and Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL )'s YouTube compete aggressively for subscribers, ad revenue, and, increasingly, sports rights. On September 14, the three put aside their rivalry to form a new lobbying group aimed at representing the streaming industry as a single, undivided voice in Washington.

The New Coalition

The Streaming Access and Choice Alliance, or SACA, debuted on September 14 with Amazon, Netflix, and YouTube as founding corporate members. It's led by TechNet, a trade association that describes itself as a national, bipartisan network of technology CEOs and senior executives that promotes the growth of American innovation. Mike Ward, TechNet Senior Vice President of Federal Policy and Government Relations, stands at the helm. Ward defined the group's mission as consumer flexibility: Americans want more content options and flexibility in how and where they watch programming, including sports and other live events, and he argued that the streaming industry and its customers deserve a dedicated voice advocating for policies that promote innovation.

Why Now

The timing is closely related to an ongoing regulatory struggle. Earlier this year, the Justice Department opened an antitrust investigation into NFL broadcasting practices, while the FCC separately sought public comment on developments in the sports-broadcasting marketplace and their impact on consumers and broadcast. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr has explicitly questioned whether leagues can continue benefitting from the Sports Broadcasting Act's antitrust exemption as more games move from traditional broadcast television to streaming services.

That backdrop explains why three companies that spend massive sums outbidding each other for sports rights, Amazon's NFL "Thursday Night Football" package, Netflix's expanding live sports schedule, which includes NFL games, and YouTube's NFL Sunday Ticket, have a real shared incentive to present a united front. If the legal or regulatory framework governing leaguewide sports-rights packages changes, it could alter how those rights are structured, negotiated and distributed, affecting all three platforms to varying degrees.

Hedge Fund Positioning

The institutional positioning among the three companies has recently shifted in different directions. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)'s hedge fund holdings increased from 353 funds in the first quarter to 369 in the second, cementing its position as one of the most commonly held companies among institutional investors. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL), Google's parent company, witnessed a comparable increase, from 265 funds to 275. Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) moved in the opposite direction, with hedge fund ownership falling from 144 to 121 over the same period, a notable drop that predates the emergence of this coalition but suggests some institutional caution.

Story Continues

What's Really At Stake

The founding of SACA is less about any single company's competitive position and more about defending a shared, structural interest: the capacity to continue bidding for and purchasing sports rights without incurring new regulatory friction. A weaker or misinterpreted Sports Broadcasting Act might alter how leagues can package and sell rights, potentially undermining the economics that all three platforms have built their sports strategy on. That said, given Amazon, Netflix, and YouTube all have different-sized, differently-structured bets on live sports, some more central to their business than others, any regulatory change would most likely have an uneven impact on the three, even though the group is presenting a unified position for the time being.

The Bottom Line

Investors should keep an eye on how the how the DOJ's antitrust investigation and the FCC's separate examination of the sports-broadcasting marketplace progress in the coming months, as any formal rule changes or legislative action could provide the clearest indication of whether streaming sports rights face new constraints.

While we acknowledge the potential of AMZN as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Amazon has some good news for its employees on minimum wage
news.Content:
Amazon employs hundreds of thousands of people in warehouses and delivery operations across the United States. On September 16, it told them their pay is going up.

The company announced a $1-per-hour raise for eligible U.S. core operations employees, bringing the minimum starting wage for full-time roles to $20 an hour, according to Amazon's press release . Average hourly pay for core operations workers rises to nearly $24. With benefits factored in, average total compensation exceeds $32 an hour. Amazon said the minimum starting wage has now risen more than 17% over the past three years.

What the $1.5 billion investment actually covers

Amazon said the pay increases will cost more than $1.5 billion. The investment covers workers involved in fulfilling and delivering customer orders, including fulfillment-center workers and delivery drivers. Amazon did not describe it as a companywide raise for every employee.

Udit Madan, Amazon's senior vice president of Worldwide Operations, said the company evaluates pay and benefits annually. "I often hear that they appreciate a good paycheck, but also really value the full range of benefits that we offer, which together help them support their families and grow in the long run," he wrote in a blog post announcing the changes.

More Amazon:

JPMorgan resets Amazon stock target after AI payoff

Amazon CEO Jassy may deliver a July 30 AWS earnings shock

Amazon stock slides as Prime Day data reveals shopper shift ahead of earnings

For a full-time employee working 40 hours a week year-round, the $1-per-hour increase works out to about $2,080 more annually before taxes. The $1.5 billion figure is a significant outlay in absolute terms and comes to roughly 0.06% of Amazon's current market capitalization of about $2.68 trillion.

The federal minimum wage is $7.25 and Congress has not raised it since 2009. Amazon's new $20 floor is nearly triple that. Many states have passed their own higher minimums, some above $15, so Amazon's starting wage lands above most state floors too. The company says it sets pay by looking at what it takes to fill and keep positions in its busiest markets.

What new benefits Amazon is adding

The pay increase comes alongside a new banking benefit and grocery discounts, both effective October 1, 2026.

Amazon is giving employees access to Day 1 Financial, a lifetime membership in First Tech Federal Credit Union. Qualified employees and their families keep the membership for life. Access begins rolling out in late 2026 and is expected to be broadly available in 2027. The credit union is federally insured by the National Credit Union Administration.

Story Continues

On groceries, Amazon employees will get 10% off eligible fresh groceries and everyday essentials on Amazon.com and Whole Foods Market online, and 20% off in-store at Whole Foods Market, according to Amazon . The discount is uncapped and can be stacked with existing Prime member discounts.

Amazon already offers full-time employees free Prime membership, prepaid education up to $5,250 annually through its Career Choice program, health-care coverage from day one, a 401(k) with company match and paid parental leave.

How workers are reacting to the news

The reaction among some Amazon workers has been mixed. On a Reddit forum for Amazon employees, several comments questioned whether the Whole Foods grocery discount would amount to meaningful savings in practice, given the chain's reputation for higher prices than typical grocery stores. One commenter said the 20% discount might bring Whole Foods prices roughly in line with a regular supermarket.

The wage increase shows up in every paycheck. The Whole Foods discount only helps workers who actually shop there. Many Amazon fulfillment-center employees are in suburban and rural areas where Whole Foods locations are sparse. A 20% discount on a grocery chain that runs 30% to 40% above average market prices still leaves workers paying more than they would at a standard supermarket.

Yahoo Finance reported the Reddit comments were highlighted by Amazon itself in materials it shared with media, framing the employee skepticism as good-natured.

The banking benefit drew a more positive response. Access to a federally insured credit union with lifetime membership is a tangible financial tool, particularly for workers who are unbanked or underbanked. About 4.2% of U.S. households have no bank account, according to the FDIC , and a larger share use high-fee check-cashing or payday lending services. A credit union membership with low fees and competitive rates addresses a real gap for that group.

What this means for Amazon and its workforce

Hourly workers have more options than they did five years ago. Walmart's average U.S. frontline associate wage now tops $18 an hour, according to Walmart . Target, Costco and other large retailers have done the same. Amazon warehouse jobs have a reputation for fast pace and physical demand, so the pay premium has to justify that to workers who could go elsewhere.

The company has also faced years of criticism over warehouse working conditions, injury rates and worker organizing efforts. Higher pay addresses one dimension of employee concerns but does not resolve questions about workload, pace of work or scheduling flexibility that have driven some of the tension between Amazon and its workers.

For investors, the $1.5 billion figure is worth context. Amazon generated more than $100 billion in operating cash flow in its most recent fiscal year, according to Yahoo Finance . The wage investment is meaningful for the workers receiving it, but manageable at the company's scale.

Labor costs are one of the largest line items in Amazon's operations. The company has been investing heavily in robotics and automation across its fulfillment network, partly to offset rising labor expenses over time. Higher wages make the automation investment look more attractive from a cost standpoint, since it raises the threshold at which machines become cheaper than people. Amazon will report how labor costs are trending when it releases its next quarterly earnings results.

news.Title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Advanced Micro Devices vs. SK Hynix
news.Content:
As the artificial intelligence boom shifts into a more mature phase, should you choose to invest in the processing power of Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) or the essential memory infrastructure of SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY)?

AMD specializes in the brains of computing, designing processors that power cloud servers and gaming consoles. SK Hynix focuses on the storage components, such as High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), which are indispensable for training complex AI models. Together, they represent two critical, yet distinct, pillars of the global hardware ecosystem.

The case for Advanced Micro Devices

Advanced Micro Devices designs and sells high-performance computing components for data centers and gaming markets. The company provides specialized chips for major clients like Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) and Sony . In late 2025, the company secured a strategic partnership with OpenAI to supply powerful graphics processors for AI infrastructure.

In its 2025 fiscal year (FY), revenue reached $34.6 billion, representing a significant 34.3% increase over the previous year. This growth supported a net income of $4.3 billion for the period. The net margin, which measures the percentage of revenue remaining after all expenses, improved to 12.5%.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 0.1x. This ratio shows how much debt the company has relative to what shareholders own. The current ratio stands at 2.9x, indicating that the business has nearly three times more short-term assets than it does liabilities due within a year. Free cash flow, or the cash left after paying for capital assets, was $6.7 billion. Note that stock-based compensation (SBC) represented 21.2% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for SK Hynix

SK Hynix is a global leader among semiconductor stocks . It produces high-speed memory chips and storage solutions essential for servers, mobile devices, and artificial intelligence hardware. While the company does not disclose individual major customers in its filings, its memory products are vital for most large-scale data centers. Its strategy focuses on advancing High Bandwidth Memory technology to meet the rising storage demands of complex software.

In FY 2025, revenue reached 97.2 trillion Korean won, a massive 46.8% jump from the previous fiscal year. This surge led to a net income of 42.9 trillion won. The net margin for the period was 44.2%, reflecting a high level of profitability relative to total sales.

Story Continues

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 0.2x. This indicates a conservative level of total debt relative to shareholder equity. The current ratio is 1.9x, meaning the company possesses nearly double the short-term assets required to cover its immediate obligations. Free cash flow was approximately 18.2 trillion won, providing substantial capital for further research and expansion.

Risk profile comparison

Advanced Micro Devices faces intense competition from established rivals like Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) and Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA). These competitors often have greater financial resources to spend on research or influence large customers. The company also relies heavily on third-party manufacturing partners such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (NYSE:TSM). This creates risks related to production capacity and supply chain delays. Geopolitical tensions and export controls on products sold to China have also led to inventory charges. Finally, the business is technologically dependent on third-party software ecosystems from partners like Microsoft.

SK Hynix operates in a highly cyclical industry where memory prices can fluctuate wildly based on global supply and demand. Competition from other large manufacturers, such as Samsung Electronics (OTC:SSNLF), can lead to price wars that erode profitability. The company also faces risks related to the significant capital expenditures required to maintain cutting-edge manufacturing facilities. Additionally, fluctuations in consumer electronics demand for PCs and smartphones can negatively impact its revenue outside of the data center market.

Valuation comparison

SK Hynix trades at a significantly lower Forward P/E and P/S ratio relative to AMD.
